name: federer
playingStyle: Aggressive all-court player, elegant one-handed backhand
careerHighlights: 2003-2007: Dominant period, won 12 of 18 Grand Slams
2008 Wimbledon Final: Lost to Nadal in epic 5-set match (considered greatest match ever)
2009 French Open: Completed career Grand Slam
2017: Won Australian Open and Wimbledon at age 35-36
2018: Reached No. 1 ranking at age 36 (oldest ever)

name: nadal
playingStyle: Aggressive baseliner, heavy topspin forehand, clay court specialist
careerHighlights: 2005-2022: Won 14 French Opens, lost only 3 times
2008 Wimbledon: Defeated Federer in epic final
2009 Australian Open: Won first hard court Grand Slam
2010: Won all 3 clay court Masters (Monte Carlo, Madrid, Rome)
2022: Won Australian Open and French Open at age 35-36

name: djokovic
playingStyle: Defensive baseliner, incredible return of serve, flexibility
careerHighlights: 2011: Won 3 Grand Slams, 5 Masters, 10 titles total
2015-2016: Won 4 consecutive Grand Slams (Novak Slam)
2021: Won 3 Grand Slams, completed second Career Grand Slam
2023: Won 3 Grand Slams at age 36
2024: Won Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon

name: sampras
playingStyle: Serve-and-volley, powerful serve, aggressive net play
careerHighlights: 1990: Youngest US Open champion at 19
1993-1998: Won 6 of 7 Wimbledons
2000: Won Wimbledon, completing 13 Grand Slams
2002: Won US Open, final match of career

name: agassi
playingStyle: Aggressive baseliner, powerful groundstrokes, return of serve
notableAchievements: Career Grand Slam (one of 8 men to achieve)
careerHighlights: 1992: Won Wimbledon, first Grand Slam
1995: Won Australian Open, reached No. 1
1999: Won French Open, completed Career Grand Slam
2003: Won Australian Open at age 32

name: mcenroe
careerHighlights: 1980: Lost epic Wimbledon final to Borg
1981: Won Wimbledon, ended Borg's streak
1984: Won 13 titles, 82-3 record
1980-1984: Dominant period, won 4 US Opens

name: borg
playingStyle: Aggressive baseliner, two-handed backhand, ice-cold demeanor
careerHighlights: 1974: Won first French Open at 18
1976-1980: Won 5 consecutive Wimbledons
1980: Epic Wimbledon final vs McEnroe (won in 5 sets)
1981: Retired at age 25, shocking the tennis world

name: connors
playingStyle: Aggressive baseliner, two-handed backhand, competitive fire
careerHighlights: 1974: Won 3 Grand Slams (Australian, Wimbledon, US Open)
1974-1978: Won 5 US Opens
1991: Reached US Open semifinals at age 39
Longest professional career in Open Era

name: rafter
careerHighlights: 1997: Won first US Open, defeating Greg Rusedski in final
1998: Defended US Open title, defeating Mark Philippoussis
1999: Reached World No. 1 ranking
2000: Reached Wimbledon final, lost to Sampras in epic match
2001: Reached Wimbledon final again, lost to Ivanisevic
2002: Retired at age 29
